---
title: Image watermark
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    watermark:
      image: watermark.svg
      position: top-right
      width: 30%
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'DRAFT'
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'foreground: typst-extras-watermark\(image: "watermark.svg"'
          - 'position: top \+ right'
---

Body text under an image watermark.
